Dear User

To identify underdeveloped customers vs the national Flavors mix using governed volume metrics, I need a bit more detail to create an execution-ready query:

1) Time period
- Please specify one of:
  - a specific day/week/month/quarter/year
  - MTD/QTD/YTD (anchored to the latest available date: May 26 2026)
  - a custom 445 date range

2) Customer grain
- Should we use Ship To → Customer level ('Ship To'[LT1.2 - Customer])? Or do you prefer Tradename?

3) Output focus
- Return all underdeveloped customers or just the top N by negative mix gap (e.g., top 20)?
- Include columns: Customer, Flavor mix share (%), National Flavor mix share (%), gap (pp), total UC?

4) Any filters
- Channels (all, or a specific macro/trade/sub channel)?
- Packages or product exclusions beyond Category = Flavors?
- Minimum volume threshold to avoid low-base noise (e.g., exclude customers with < X UC in the period)?

Note: This deployment only supports Colombia data, so “national” will be interpreted as Colombia.
